mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_task (id, conversation_id, prompt, python_run_id, status, result, error, created_at, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{prompt}, #{pythonRunId}, #{status}, #{result}, #{error}, #{createdAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, prompt, python_run_id, status, result, error, created_at, started_at, finished_at FROM agent_task WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at, id
